messages:
Maya (Marketing): Heads-up: we need to lock analyst pre-briefs for launch week. Proposed embargo lift: Wed 10:00am PT. Need slots, quote wording, and fact-check package.
Eli (PR): Tentatively holding calendar. Legal asked for final quotes by Tue EOD so analysts can fact-check.
Priya (Comms): Legal flagged the phrase 'industry-leading' in the draft copy. Suggest neutral wording like 'measured throughput improvement versus default configs'.
Jonas (Product): Agree. Updated benchmark top-line: median token latency down ~28% on Dedicated with our tuning. Will attach CSV. Avoid broad multipliers unless we specify workload.
Maya (Marketing): Okay. @Jonas can you produce two short quote options (technical and customer-facing)? @Zoe can we add a 9:00am PT slot for EU attendees?
Zoe (Ops): 9:00am PT is possible but we need confirmation by 3pm PT Monday to reserve the extra demo slot.
Eli (PR): Who's assembling the fact-check packet? Analysts requested raw numbers, model names, and the test harness link.
Jonas (Product): I'll pull the perf CSV and include the runbook snippet. Top of package: model: redwood-v1-finetuned; hardware: 8xA100; batching: dynamic; seq_len: 1024; dataset: benchmark-suite-v3. Will anonymize traces.
Priya (Comms): For quotes: two short variants please. Legal will review and sign off.
Maya (Marketing): Draft quotes: Tech: "Our Dedicated config reduced median token latency by 28% on representative RL workloads." Customer: "Customers saw meaningful latency improvements while lowering per-token cost"
Eli (PR): Add attribution: "- Maya Leung, Head of Marketing, Redwood Inference" and a one-line embargo explainer.
PressBot: Embargo reminder set: embargo lift 2026-03-24 10:00 PT. Fact-check deadline 2026-03-23 17:00 PT.
Priya (Comms): Analyst asked for raw traces; we'll provide an aggregated CSV plus a privacy note that client traces are anonymized per policy.
Jonas (Product): Affirmative. I'll redact hostnames and remove identifiers.
Zoe (Ops): Note: if embargo moves later than Wed 10:00 PT we need 12 hours notice to update media invites.
Maya (Marketing): One analyst requested a live demo. Can we prepare an 8-10 minute script focusing on latency and rollout UI?
Jonas (Product): Yes. I'll produce a 10-step demo script and record a fallback video in case of infra issues.
Eli (PR): I'll draft invites including both quote variants and the perf CSV link. Please deliver final assets by Tue EOD. :thumbsup:
Maya (Marketing): Will post final package here when ready. Thanks team!"
